def test_tc081_2_strip(tmp_path: Path) -> None: """The strip resolves once, above its buttons, fed by a defaulted parameter.
Intent (LLR-081.2, C-7): DOM order is asserted because "the strip labels the Undo/Redo row" is a reading-order claim no functional AT can see (the Inc-4 M-5 lesson). The panel is a VIEW: it must not import the service layer nor reach ``self.app``, or the Patch screen stops being testable without a full app.
